title: Optional component charge review
description: review_package(request) validates all input before evaluating alternatives; invalid input raises ValueError (message unspecified). Do not mutate input. All components are optional; any subset including empty is allowed. Its charge is base_cost plus the cost of each selected component plus every adjustment whose two members are both selected. Signed costs represent charges or credits; repeated and reversed adjustments are separate additive entries, never deduplicated. Return component_count, base_cost, current, lowest_cost, avoidable_cost. current contains selected in component input order, component_cost, applied_adjustment_indices in adjustment input order (zero-based), adjustment_cost, total_cost. lowest_cost is the exact least attainable total charge over all subsets. avoidable_cost equals current.total_cost minus lowest_cost; it is nonnegative. Do not return or require a particular attaining subset; ties do not affect the numeric result. Empty catalogues return base_cost. CLI reads one JSON request and prints one report; invalid input has nonzero exit and no successful report.
